audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer called this HARD 8/10 with Taliyah winning all seven level rows. The content layer, the packet level chart and a 58.1% win rate over 821 games all say the opposite.
audit.why: Katarina wins every stage here: Threaded Volley roots Taliyah in place while she funnels, Seismic Shove is the only setup her burst has and Shunpo answers it, and at 6 a combat ultimate beats a utility wall.
audit.corrected: diff HARD to FAVOURED, tone to the palette's FAVOURED green, diffRating 8/10 to 3/10, carryRating 8.5/10 to 4/10, all seven sides to Katarina with matching ratings and rewritten whys.

audit.why: Level 6 is Katarina's biggest spike because Weaver's Wall (180/150/120s) grants no combat stats while Death Lotus (75/60/45s) is a kill button; first item compounds it.
audit.corrected: Phase ratings weighted so level 6 is the strongest row.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns had no digits, and dontsFull[2] warned about spell-shield kits which Taliyah does not have. The real dominant interaction — Unraveled Earth detonating on your Shunpo — was nowhere in the full layer.
audit.why: Unraveled Earth explicitly stuns enemies who dash through it, and Shunpo is a dash. That is the one way Taliyah punishes Katarina's engage and it belongs on the page. Seismic Shove 14/12.5/11/9.5/8s, Unraveled Earth flat 14s, Threaded Volley 7/6/5/4/3s.
audit.corrected: Cooldowns rewritten with all three numbers plus the mine-detonation rule; dontsFull[2] retitled to the mine field.
